raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 (ingested 2026-01-18, covering txn date 2026-01-17) was delivered with amount_unit='USD_CENTS' on all 327 of its rows, so amounts are 100x too large. silver_transactions treats every amount as USD, which inflates the mean to 4409 against a median of 42.25.
